subject: Developer Onboarding Webinar — behavioral-triggered invite list & tracking plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex@opensourcedevhub.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Developer Onboarding Webinar — behavioral-triggered invite list & tracking plan

Team / Alex —

Following up on the co-hosted mini-webinar we agreed with OpenSource Dev Hub. High-level ask: I want a tight inbound invite send that activates based on recent product behavior (so we prioritize folks who are actually onboarding or trialing). Goals: 250 engaged RSVPs, 150 live attendees, and a clean seedlist for rep follow-up.

Key constraints: 1) Keep send velocity conservative for trial customers (avoid throttling their onboarding emails). 2) Use per-recipient link rotation to measure click attribution across partner vs. Redwood CTA. 3) Ensure bounce / suppression checks before first send.

Attached: seedlist_behavioral_segments.csv (proposed segments), email_copy_variants_v3.docx (short/long subject + snippet), tracking-link-rotation-sheet.csv (UTM + per-link fingerprints).

Proposed behavioral segments (from the csv):
- Recent sign-ups (last 14 days) who started onboarding flow but did not run a model (high priority).
- Trial users with >2 model runs in last 7 days (engaged).
- Signed-up devs who clicked docs/tutorial in the last 30 days (content-engaged).

Trigger rules (proposal):
- Primary send when user first opens onboarding checklist email OR performs a first model run event (whichever comes first).
- 1st reminder: 48 hours after no RSVP + open event -> send short reminder.
- 2nd reminder: 72 hours before webinar to last-chance segment (only if user clicked initial invite).

Tracking / attribution asks:
- Use per-link query params: utm_campaign=oss-dev-onboard-0626, utm_source={partner|redwood}, utm_medium=email, link_id={A..F} to rotate.
- Fingerprint header: append a short path token (lnk=rw-<link_id>-<seg>) so our analytics can stitch multiple clicks to a single recipient even if UTM is stripped. The sheet shows rotation mapping.

Ops asks (who owns):
- Marissa: seedlist verification + bounce clean (before 06/28 12:00 PT).
- Karthik: tracking links + HubSpot mapping (ensure event properties: click_link_id, source_channel).
- Stephanie: cadence and subject testing; run A/B on subject snippets only (no copy changes) for the primary send.

Alex — can you confirm the co-host CTA placement (partner logo + registration-first vs. partner-first) and if OS Dev Hub wants the partner intro slide (30s)? Also confirm any compliance/legal constraints for behavioral targeting on your side.

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: seedlist_behavioral_segments.csv (CSV), email_copy_variants_v3.docx (DOCX), tracking-link-rotation-sheet.csv (CSV)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex@opensourcedevhub.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Developer Onboarding Webinar — behavioral-triggered invite list & tracking plan

Thanks Logan — reviewed the segments and have a few adjustments after a quick seedlist QA run. Notes below + action items.

Seedlist QA results (quick summary):
- Removed ~420 addresses flagged as role-based / catch-all (admin@, info@, noreply@).
- Flagged ~58 addresses with recent hard-bounces in the past 90 days — recommending suppression before any send.
- Split the Recent Sign-ups segment into two windows: 0–7 days (urgent) and 8–14 days (standard) so cadence and creative can be slightly different.

Creative suggestions (for subject testing):
- Test A: "Quick intro: Build & ship LLM features — free workshop" (short, product benefit)
- Test B: "Join our hands-on onboarding lab with OpenSource Dev Hub" (partner-forward)
- Add a 1-line personalization token in preheader for users who hit docs: "Saw you peeked at the Getting Started guide — this lab helps finish setup"

Link rotation note: the tracking sheet maps link_id A..F to partner/redwood CTAs. Karthik — please ensure that link fingerprint token is URL-safe (no spaces / +).

Compliance: Alex — we removed any emails flagged by your suppression list and filtered Do Not Contact tags. I still need a final OK from you that the behavioral trigger rules are compliant with your privacy policy (especially for EU residents).

Timeline:
- Seedlist clean complete by 06/28 10:00 PT (I will run a final suppression pass).
- Final creative & link sheet freeze by 06/29 EOD.
- Primary send window: 07/01 09:00–13:00 PT (US-day cohort), staggered by timezone for APAC/EU).

If no objections I’ll start the clean now and upload the final CSV to the shared drive (link in HubSpot record).

Marissa
Senior Growth Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Developer Onboarding Webinar — behavioral-triggered invite list & tracking plan

Hi Logan / Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough plan — looks good from OS Dev Hub side. Quick answers:
- We’re fine with the behavioral targets you described (we’ll surface necessary DNC flags from our CRM).
- Partner CTA: we prefer partner logo + registration-first (short blurbs in the body). Open to a 30s partner introduction slide.
- Compliance: we have EU guests on our lists; our legal team confirms the triggers are okay so long as we honor unsubscribe/DNC and do not use any sensitive attribute for segmentation. I’ll send a confirmation note from legal before the final send.

Two small asks: 1) Can you add a separate link_id that routes to a partner-specific thank-you page (so we can track post-reg partner CTAs)? 2) Can you limit the last-chance reminder to only users who clicked at least one link but didn’t register (behavioral last-touch)?

We’ll remove partner-suppressed emails and send our final suppression list by 06/28 14:00 ET.

Alex
Partnerships Manager
OpenSource Dev Hub

Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Developer Onboarding Webinar — behavioral-triggered invite list & tracking plan

All — quick operational update now that I’ve wired the tracking sheet into HubSpot:
- Link rotation implemented (A..G) and each lead will get deterministic link_id on send. I added partner-only thank-you link as link_id=G per Alex’s ask.
- Mapped properties: utm_campaign, click_link_id, partner_source, seed_segment. I also added a boolean property (behavioral_triggered) for downstream CS handoff.
- I created a simple workflow: when click_link_id != null and registration != true -> add to "last-chance-clickers" and send last-chance reminder 72h before event (only for clickers).

Marissa — I left the seedlist CSV in the shared folder with the cleaned file name: seedlist_behavioral_segments_clean.csv.

Stephanie — subject-A/B scheduled as requested; I set sample size to 20% of the primary send to preserve statistical power.

Logan — we’re green from tracking side. Anything else before final creative freeze?

Karthik
Growth Ops
Redwood Inference
